item.title: Mullin Clashes with Lawmakers, Peltola Flips Alaska, FDA Nominee Overton Pulled: AM Update 11/19 (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Top Trump administration officials rule out a coordinated cyberattack behind recent nationwide outages as Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin faces heated questioning over his government aircraft travel and immigration enforcement policies. House Democrats overwhelmingly nominate Hakeem Jeffries to become the next Speaker of the House despite opposition from progressive lawmakers demanding stronger policy commitments. Democrat Mary Peltola flips Alaska's Senate seat, expanding her party's majority to 56 seats as a federal grand jury investigates allegations of an effort to confuse Republican voters. President Trump withdraws Dr. Heidi Overton's nomination to lead the FDA amid Republican opposition and controversy over vaccines, vaping, abortion policy, and agricultural regulations.
